home.title: RetroPDF · PDF tools that never upload your files
home.description: Merge, split, rotate and edit PDFs in your browser. Your files stay on your device. No account, no limits, no uploads.
home.heading: Free PDF tools. Your files stay on your device.
home.lede: Merge, split and rotate PDFs without sending them anywhere.
home.tools_heading: Pick the tool that matches your task.
home.info.other_sites: Most free PDF websites send your document to a company’s server, change it there, and send it back. Your files end up somewhere you cannot see, and you have to trust that they are deleted.
home.info.we_differ: Here, everything runs inside your browser, on your device. Your file is never sent anywhere. That is also why there is no waiting and no daily limit: your own device does the work, not ours.
home.info.yours: Your passport, your contract, your bank statement. Whatever you are working on, it stays yours.

tool.merge-pdf.name: Merge PDF
tool.merge-pdf.heading: Combine PDFs into one file.
tool.merge-pdf.blurb: Put several PDFs together in the order you choose.
tool.merge-pdf.steps: Select two or more PDFs, drag them into order, then download.
tool.merge-pdf.title: Merge PDF · RetroPDF
tool.merge-pdf.description: Combine PDF files into one document. Nothing is uploaded: the merge happens on your own device, so your files stay private.
tool.remove-pdf-pages.name: Delete PDF pages
tool.remove-pdf-pages.heading: Delete pages from a PDF.
tool.remove-pdf-pages.blurb: Pick the pages you do not want and keep the rest.
tool.remove-pdf-pages.steps: Select a PDF, click the pages you want gone, then download the rest.
tool.remove-pdf-pages.title: Delete PDF pages · RetroPDF
tool.remove-pdf-pages.description: Delete pages from a PDF without uploading it. The file never leaves your device, so private documents stay private.
tool.extract-pdf-pages.name: Extract PDF pages
tool.extract-pdf-pages.heading: Save some pages as a new PDF.
tool.extract-pdf-pages.blurb: Pick the pages you want and save them as a new file.
tool.extract-pdf-pages.steps: Select a PDF, click the pages you want to keep, then download them.
tool.extract-pdf-pages.title: Extract PDF pages · RetroPDF
tool.extract-pdf-pages.description: Save selected pages of a PDF as a new file. Everything happens in your browser, with no upload and no account.
tool.reorder-pdf.name: Reorder PDF pages
tool.reorder-pdf.heading: Change the order of PDF pages.
tool.reorder-pdf.blurb: Drag pages into the order you want.
tool.reorder-pdf.steps: Select a PDF, drag the pages into the order you want, then download.
tool.reorder-pdf.title: Reorder PDF pages · RetroPDF
tool.reorder-pdf.description: Rearrange the pages of a PDF. Nothing is uploaded, so the document stays on your own device.
tool.rotate-pdf.name: Rotate PDF
tool.rotate-pdf.heading: Turn sideways pages upright.
tool.rotate-pdf.blurb: Turn pages that are sideways or upside down.
tool.rotate-pdf.steps: Select a PDF, turn any page that is sideways, then download.
tool.rotate-pdf.title: Rotate PDF · RetroPDF
tool.rotate-pdf.description: Turn PDF pages the right way up, one page or all of them. Runs entirely in your browser with no upload.
tool.split-pdf.name: Split PDF
tool.split-pdf.heading: Cut one PDF into several files.
tool.split-pdf.blurb: Cut one PDF into several smaller files.
tool.split-pdf.steps: Select a PDF, pick where to cut, then download the parts as a zip.
tool.split-pdf.title: Split PDF · RetroPDF
tool.split-pdf.description: Cut a PDF into separate files and download them as a zip. The file is never uploaded anywhere.
tool.jpg-to-pdf.name: Images to PDF
tool.jpg-to-pdf.heading: Turn photos into a PDF.
tool.jpg-to-pdf.blurb: Put your JPG or PNG images into one PDF.
tool.jpg-to-pdf.steps: Select your JPG or PNG images, drag them into order, then download one PDF.
tool.jpg-to-pdf.title: JPG to PDF · RetroPDF
tool.jpg-to-pdf.description: Turn JPG and PNG images into one PDF. The pictures stay on your device, which matters for photos of documents and ID.
tool.pdf-to-jpg.name: PDF to images
tool.pdf-to-jpg.heading: Save PDF pages as pictures.
tool.pdf-to-jpg.blurb: Save every page as a separate PNG or JPG.
tool.pdf-to-jpg.steps: Select a PDF, pick a size, then download every page as an image.
tool.pdf-to-jpg.title: PDF to JPG · RetroPDF
tool.pdf-to-jpg.description: Save each page of a PDF as a PNG image. Runs on your own device, so nothing is uploaded.
